title: Houlihan Lokey Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
summary: – First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Revenues of $511 million – – First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Diluted EPS of $1.15 – – Adjusted First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Diluted EPS of $1.35 – – Announces Dividend of $0.70 per Share for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 – Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) (“Houlihan Lokey” or the “Company”) today reported financial results for its first quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, revenues were $511 million, compared with $605 million for the first quarter ended June 30, 2025. Net income attributable to Houlihan Lokey, Inc. was $78 million, or $1.15 per diluted share, for the first quarter ended June 30, 2026, compared with $98 million, or $1.42 per diluted share, for the first quarter ended June 30, 2025.
